name: Dana Okafor
headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Python and Go | Payments ledgers and warehouse systems
summary: Backend engineer with nine years in Python, most recently on a card-issuing ledger. Works where correctness is checked rather than assumed: reconciliation, retries that cannot double-post, and alerts that page for a reason. Has written warehouse booking APIs and moved large Postgres tables without stopping the business. Shares on-call and fixes what pages her.

bullets: Rebuilt the daily settlement-file reconciliation in Python, with a finance review queue for unmatched lines.
Replaced static threshold alerts with SLO burn-rate alerts in Datadog and wrote runbooks for the most frequent pages.
Wrote the Python client library for the card tokenisation project and moved four services onto it, working with the security team.
Wrote the dock-appointment booking API that carriers call to reserve unloading slots.
Moved the tracking-events table to monthly Postgres partitions and archived older months to S3.
Moved label-printing workers from always-on EC2 instances to Lambda functions fed by SQS.
Split the pytest suite to run in parallel with per-test Postgres containers from Testcontainers.
Built a FastAPI booking service with Twilio SMS reminders for a group of physiotherapy clinics.
Rewrote the C# interface that sends lab results to the patient-records system as HL7 messages, with validation and a retry queue.
